fields.description: Nobu Residences Abu Dhabi is Aldar’s beachfront collection at Mamsha Al Saadiyat. The announced 88 residences combine apartments, lofts and larger private residences with a Japanese-influenced design approach and access to a wider hotel and dining destination.
amenities: Hotel spa, steam room and sauna

sources.label: Aldar launch disclosure, 14 November 2023, via ADX
Aldar: Nobu brochure and floor plans
Aldar FY2025 results: UAE residential pipeline, page 27

reviewCoverage.identity: Aldar’s Abu Dhabi project checked separately from the unrelated Al Marjan development and portal phase-two label.
reviewCoverage.location: Mamsha Al Saadiyat and the cultural-district beachfront confirmed by Aldar launch.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official brochure shows apartments, two-bedroom lofts, sky villas and penthouses.
reviewCoverage.areas: Six numerical typical-plan totals visually checked in official brochure; individual contract sizes may differ.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Developer facilities distinguished from hotel-linked services; access and fees remain contract-specific.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Official brochure has no current price schedule. Conflicting portal launch/current figures excluded from numeric price.
reviewCoverage.payment: Portal 70/30 plan corroborated by Bayut; Property Finder supplies 10/60/30. Current signed schedule not recovered.
reviewCoverage.handover: Original Q2 2027, FY2025 annual pipeline 2027 and later portal Q4 2027 reconciled as an estimated year with quarter unconfirmed.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 62-page brochure downloaded; plan pages 36–38 and 49–52 visually inspected.

overview: The residential design was announced with RSP Architects and Studio PCH. Kitchens were developed with input from Chef Nobu, while the bathrooms draw on Japanese and Arabian bathing traditions. Alongside the homes, the wider development includes a Nobu hotel, restaurant and rooftop bar.
research.locationNote: The project sits on Mamsha Al Saadiyat’s beachfront in Saadiyat Cultural District. Aldar describes outlooks toward the Gulf and Guggenheim Abu Dhabi; an individual apartment’s actual outlook depends on its position.
research.priceNote: No current developer price schedule was recovered. Property Finder mixes a AED 7.5m current headline with older AED 3.6m references; Bayut lists AED 4.1m as a launch figure. None establishes today’s available entry price.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% booking, 60% during construction and 30% at handover. Bayut corroborates the overall 70/30 split. A resale transfer may require a different immediate payment.
research.handoverNote: FY2025 pipeline: 2027. The original launch stated Q2 2027; current Property Finder and Bayut pages report Q4 2027. The final quarter requires written developer confirmation.

facts.label: Original residential collection
facts.value: The November 2023 announcement identifies 88 residences. This is the announced collection size, not a statement of remaining stock.

facts.label: Layout distinction
facts.value: The brochure separates hotel-residence floor plates from the beach-residence plates. Select the correct building and unit drawing before comparing a loft, apartment or sky villa.
